From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-16T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Pen test report & vuln management details for FinTechCo

Looping in a few technical details that we can share with FinTechCo — happy to be on a short call if they want deeper context. High level: 

- Pen test cadence: third-party full external penetration test annually, and after any material change (major product release or new infra change). We also engage an independent firm for scope that includes public endpoints and critical workflows.
- Internal scanning: nightly SAST/SCA jobs, weekly DAST for staging, and continuous dependency scanning with automated alerting into our issue tracker.
- Vulnerability acknowledgement SLAs: we commit to acknowledging reports within 24 hours.
- Remediation SLAs (target windows after acknowledgement): Critical: 30 days (hotfix/rollback earlier if exploited); High: 60 days; Medium: 90 days; Low: remediation in next regular cycle or mitigated via compensating controls. These targets are reflected in the attached vuln-management-sla.xlsx.
- Disclosure policy: coordinated disclosure by default; we request 90 days before public disclosure so we can remediate, faster coordination for actively exploited critical issues. We maintain a bug-bounty & coordinated disclosure program (details available under NDA).
- Report sharing: we can provide a redacted pen-test summary publicly (already sent). Full reports require an executed NDA / DPA. For very large enterprises we can provide a redacted version plus an in-person readout with the testing firm if required.

If FinTechCo needs any changes to SLA windows for contract negotiation, let us know and we can propose alternative remediation timelines for the contract.

-Rishi
Director, Applied Security | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: vuln-management-sla.xlsx (same as Laura's copy)
